{{Quote|See anything you like, give me a wink.|Bekhaj|<ref name="CodexHutta">{{TORcite|type=codex|Hutta}}</ref>}}
'''Bekhaj''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Evocii]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
During the war, he worked as a merchant on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of his [[Species/Legends|species]] previously known as Evocar, but taken over and renamed by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species who adopted it as their homeworld.<ref name="CodexHutta" /> On Hutta he owned a small stall near the entrance to [[Jiguuna]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> an industrial town controlled by a Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Suudaa Nem'ro]].<ref name="CodexJiguuna">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jiguuna}}</ref> The stall consisted of a series of shelves filled with the goods he sold, which included stims and [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]]<ref name="SWTOR" /> As all merchants in Jiguuna were, Bekhaj was expected to pay some of his profits from his stall to one of Nem'ro's lieutenants at the crime lord's [[Nem'ro's Palace|palace]].<ref name="CodexNem'roP">{{TORcite|type=codex|Nem'ro's Palace}}</ref> Whilst at the stall the Evocii wore a piece of head-wear which revealed the top of his head as well as [[Color/Legends|brown]] clothing. Bekhaj had pale yellow skin, blue eyes and was bald.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bekhaj first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He appears as a stims vendor on the planet Nal Hutta, the starting planet for players of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Imperial Agent]] class.
